an5.48:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcimāni bhikkhave alabbhanīyāni ṭhānāni samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ.
an5.48:1.3: ‘jarādhammaṃ mā jīrīti’ alabbhanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ.
an5.48:1.4: ‘vyādhidhammaṃ mā vyādhīyī’ti …pe… ‘maraṇadhammaṃ mā mīyī’ti …pe… ‘khayadhammaṃ mā khīyī’ti …pe… ‘nassanadhammaṃ mā nassī’ti alabbhanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ.
an5.48:2.2: so jarādhamme jiṇṇe na iti paṭisañcikkhati:
an5.48:2.3: “na kho mayhamevekassa jarādhammaṃ jīrati. atha kho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati, gati, cuti, upapatti’ sabbesaṃ sattānaṃ jarādhammaṃ jīrati.
an5.48:2.4: ahañceva kho pana jarādhamme jiṇṇe soceyyaṃ, kilameyyaṃ, parideveyyaṃ, urattāḷiṃ kandeyyaṃ, sammohaṃ āpajjeyyaṃ, bhattampi me nacchādeyya. kāyepi dubbaṇṇiyaṃ okkameyya. kammantāpi nappavatteyyuṃ. amittāpi attamanā assu. mittāpi dummanā assū”ti.
an5.48:2.5: so jarādhamme jiṇṇe socati, kilamati, paridevati, urattāḷiṃ kandati, sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an5.48:2.7: assutavā puthujjano viddho savisena sokasallena attānaṃ yeva paritāpeti.
an5.48:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave assutavato puthujjanassa byādhidhammaṃ byādhīyati …pe… maraṇadhammaṃ mīyati …pe… khayadhammaṃ khīyati …pe… nassanadhammaṃ nassati.
an5.48:3.2: so nassanadhamme naṭṭhe na iti paṭisañcikkhati:
an5.48:3.3: “na kho mayhamevekassa nassanadhammaṃ nassati. athakho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati, gati, cuti, upapatti, sabbesaṃ sattānaṃ nassanadhammaṃ nassati.
an5.48:3.4: ahañceva kho pana nassanadhamme naṭṭhe soceyyaṃ, kilameyyaṃ, parideveyyaṃ, urattāḷiṃ kandeyyaṃ, sammohaṃ āpajjeyyaṃ, bhattampi me nacchādeyya. kāyepi dubbaṇṇiyaṃ okkameyya. kammantāpi nappavatteyyuṃ. amittāpi attamanā assu. mittāpi dummanā assū”ti.
an5.48:3.5: so nassanadhamme naṭṭhe socati, kilamati, paridevati, urattāḷiṃ kandati, sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an5.48:3.7: assutavā puthujjano viddho savisena sokasallena attānaṃ yeva paritāpeti.
an5.48:4.1: sutavato ca kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa jarādhammaṃ jīrati.
an5.48:4.3: “na kho mayhamevekassa jarādhammaṃ jīrati. atha kho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati, gati, cuti, upapatti, sabbesaṃ sattānaṃ jarādhammaṃ jīrati.
an5.48:4.4: ahañceva kho pana jarādhamme jiṇṇe soceyyaṃ. kilameyyaṃ, parideveyyaṃ, urattāḷiṃ kandeyyaṃ, sammohaṃ āpajjeyyaṃ, bhattampi me nacchādeyya. kāyepi dubbaṇṇiyaṃ okkameyya, kammantāpi nappavatteyyuṃ. amittāpi attamanā assu. mittāpi dummanā assū”ti.
an5.48:4.5: so jarādhamme jiṇṇe na socati, na kilamati, na paridevati, na urattāḷiṃ kandati, na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an5.48:4.7: ariyasāvako abbahī savisaṃ sokasallaṃ yena viddho assutavā puthujjano attānaṃ yeva paritāpeti.
an5.48:4.8: asoko visallo ariyasāvako attānaṃ yeva parinibbāpeti.
an5.48:5.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave sutavato ariyasāvakassa vyādhidhammaṃ vyādhīyati …pe… maraṇadhammaṃ mīyati …pe… khayadhammaṃ khīyati …pe… nassanadhammaṃ nassati.
an5.48:5.3: “na kho mayhamevekassa nassanadhammaṃ nassati. atha kho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati, gati, cuti, upapatti, sabbesaṃ nassanadhammaṃ nassati.
an5.48:5.4: ahañceva kho pana nassanadhamme naṭṭhe soceyyaṃ, kilameyyaṃ, parideveyyaṃ, urattāḷiṃ kandeyyaṃ, sammohaṃ āpajjeyyaṃ, bhattampi me nacchādeyya. kāye pi dubbaṇṇiyaṃ okkameyya. kammantāpi nappavatteyyuṃ. amittāpi attamanā assu. mittāpi dummanā assū”ti.
an5.48:5.5: so nassanadhamme naṭṭhe na socati, na kilamati na paridevati, na urattāḷiṃ kandati, na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an5.48:5.7: sutavā ariyasāvako abbahī savisaṃ sokasallaṃ yena viddho assutavā puthujjano attānaṃ yeva paritāpeti.
an5.48:5.8: asoko visallo ariyasāvako attānaṃ yeva parinibbāpetīti.
an5.48:6.1: imāni kho bhikkhave pañca alabbhanīyāni ṭhānāni samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena devena vā mārena vā brahmunā kenaci vā lokasminti.
an5.48:10.2: mayā ca aññena vā esa attho
